_comment: Example config for the notify-router module (mcp/notify-router.ts). Copy to notify.config.json (or point NOTIFY_CONFIG at it) beside the daemon. This is the OP-NOTIFY trail — operational error/alert/info reporting, NOT a messaging lane. `severity_routes` maps each severity to the connectors that deliver it; each connector carries its OWN targets, so one severity can fan to telegram AND a buzz ops-channel. `log` is jsonl-only (everything is audited regardless). Secrets are injected by the module (TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN, BUZZ_PRIVATE_KEY) — never put tokens here.
